result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: Customer retains a one-month convenience-termination right, any early-termination charges are capped at three months’ charges, and prepaid charges covering post-termination periods must be refunded. It does not grant IBM a convenience-termination right. The edits are limited to the required cap and refund and preserve the clause’s existing scope and mechanics. Drafting is professional, though “one month” is not identical to 30 days and the refund could more expressly state that it is pro rata.
